text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast, we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 在这个播客中，我们用简单的英语进行真实对话来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 在這個播客中，我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
There's a video version of this podcast on our website.
zh: 本播客在我们的网站上有视频版本。
zh_hant: 本播客在我們的網站上有影片版本。

text: Try it at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you?
I'm very well, thank you, Neil.
How are you?
I'm very good.
I've just had my first coffee of the day.
zh: 我刚喝了今天的第一杯咖啡。
zh_hant: 我剛喝了今天的第一杯咖啡。

text: Me too.
Now we're feeling good.
We are feeling good, and we're talking about drinks today.
zh: 我们感觉很好，今天我们要聊聊饮品。
zh_hant: 我們感覺很好，今天我們要聊聊飲品。

text: Yes, we are.
We've talked a lot about food on this podcast,
zh: 我们在本播客里聊过很多关于食物的话题，
zh_hant: 我們在本播客裡聊過很多關於食物的話題，

text: but today, we're going to talk about drinks.
So, Neil, do you have a lot of hot drinks?
zh: 那么，尼尔，你喝很多热饮吗？
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你喝很多熱飲嗎？

text: Not a lot, but they are very important to me.
zh: 不算多，但它们对我很重要。
zh_hant: 不算多，但它們對我很重要。

text: I really enjoy having my coffee,
but I probably only have two a day.
zh: 但我可能一天只喝两杯。
zh_hant: 但我可能一天只喝兩杯。

text: I normally have one coffee a day in the morning.
zh: 我通常早上喝一杯咖啡。
zh_hant: 我通常早上喝一杯咖啡。

text: So here's a big question.
Do you prefer tea or coffee?
Definitely coffee.
With tea, like English breakfast tea, black tea with milk.
zh: 如果是茶，比如英式早餐茶，加牛奶的红茶。
zh_hant: 如果是茶，比如英式早餐茶，加牛奶的紅茶。

text: No, I don't like it at all.
You don't like tea?
No.
What's the matter with you?
Did you not know that I don't like tea?
zh: 你不知道我不喜欢茶吗？
zh_hant: 你不知道我不喜歡茶嗎？

text: It's horrible.
If I like tea, it's tea, like a fruit tea.
zh: 如果我喜欢喝茶，那就是果茶之类的。
zh_hant: 如果我喜歡喝茶，那就是果茶之類的。

text: Or, yeah, I'm not very good at being British, apparently.
zh: 或者，好吧，显然我不太像个英国人。
zh_hant: 或者，好吧，顯然我不太像個英國人。

text: OK.
Well, I think tea's great.
But just one.
One's fine in the morning, maybe.
zh: 早上喝一杯就够了，也许吧。
zh_hant: 早上喝一杯就夠了，也許吧。

text: OK.
But do you prefer tea to coffee?
zh: 那你更喜欢茶而不是咖啡吗？
zh_hant: 那你更喜歡茶而不是咖啡嗎？

text: I think they're really difficult to compare.
I think you can drink more tea without feeling a bit strange.
zh: 我觉得你可以多喝点茶，而不会感到任何奇怪。
zh_hant: 我覺得你可以多喝點茶，而不會感到任何奇怪。

text: If you drink too much coffee,
it can have an effect on you.
zh: 它可能会对你产生影响。
zh_hant: 它可能會對你產生影響。

text: That's true.
What about other hot drinks like hot chocolate?
zh: 那其他热饮呢，比如热巧克力？
zh_hant: 那其他熱飲呢，比如熱巧克力？

text: I love it in the winter when I'm just at home
with the fire on drinking a hot chocolate.
zh: 开着火炉喝一杯热巧克力。
zh_hant: 開著火爐喝一杯熱巧克力。

text: Yeah, that's OK.
But I don't have it very often.
No, no.
Actually, basically, sometimes when I have a cold in the winter,
zh: 实际上，基本上，有时候冬天我感冒了时，
zh_hant: 實際上，基本上，有時候冬天我感冒了時，

text: I like to slice ginger very thinly.
Yeah.
Put it in a flask with hot water and honey, sometimes lemon as well.
zh: 放进保温瓶里，加开水和蜂蜜，有时也加柠檬。
zh_hant: 放進保溫瓶裡，加開水和蜂蜜，有時也加檸檬。

text: Yeah.
And that's a really nice warming drink.
zh: 那是一种很不错的暖身饮品。
zh_hant: 那是一種很不錯的暖身飲品。

text: Yeah, definitely.
I do the same thing, honey and lemon and ginger.
zh: 我也这么做，蜂蜜、柠檬和姜。
zh_hant: 我也這麼做，蜂蜜、檸檬和姜。

text: So we talked about hot drinks,
but what about cold drinks?
Do you like fizzy drinks?
Not really, to be honest.
I mean, I like them, but I don't have them very often at all.
zh: 我的意思是，我喜欢它们，但我很少喝。
zh_hant: 我的意思是，我喜歡它們，但我很少喝。

text: So I used to have a Coke
zh: 我过去喝中餐时会配可乐。
zh_hant: 我過去喝中餐時會配可樂。

text: with a Chinese.
If I had a really spicy meal,
zh: 我会挺喜欢配着可乐喝。
zh_hant: 我會挺喜歡配著可樂喝。

text: then I would quite enjoy drinking a Coke with it.
But I don't really have Chinese very often.
And I don't really have fizzy drinks often.
No.
What about you?
No, I don't really like fizzy drinks.
They're okay.
zh: 有时它们有点难咽，因为气太多。
zh_hant: 有時它們有點難嚥，因為氣太多。

text: Sometimes they're a bit hard to swallow because they've got so much gas.
That's true.
I had a sparkling water yesterday.
zh: 所以如果让我在无气泡水和气泡水之间选，
zh_hant: 所以如果讓我在無氣泡水和氣泡水之間選，

text: So if I have the choice between still or sparkling,
I might go for a sparkling water.
zh: 而且感觉比喝柠檬水或其他汽水更健康。
zh_hant: 而且感覺比喝檸檬水或其他汽水更健康。

text: And it feels healthier than having a lemonade or something else fizzy.
Right.
I prefer still water.
zh: 我觉得无气泡水更好喝。
zh_hant: 我覺得無氣泡水更好喝。

text: I think still water is nicer.
So Neil, if you're thirsty,
zh: 你更想喝水还是果汁或浓缩果汁？
zh_hant: 你更想喝水還是果汁或濃縮果汁？

text: would you rather have water or something like juice or squash?
zh: 如果我渴了，我每次都宁愿喝水。
zh_hant: 如果我渴了，我每次都寧願喝水。

text: If I'm thirsty, I would rather have water every time.
zh: 渴的时候，水是最好的选择。
zh_hant: 渴的時候，水是最好的選擇。

text: You cannot beat water for when you're thirsty.
There's nothing like it.
Nothing like that feeling if you've done some exercise or something,
zh: 或者你真的很渴时，喝一大杯水的感觉无与伦比。
zh_hant: 或者你真的很渴時，喝一大杯水的感覺無與倫比。

text: or you're just really thirsty, of drinking a big glass of water.
I completely agree.
zh: 我觉得早餐时喝果汁有时不错，
zh_hant: 我覺得早餐時喝果汁有時不錯，

text: I think juice is nice with breakfast sometimes,
like I might have orange juice.
But squash is something very popular in the UK with some families.
zh: 但在英国，壁球在某些家庭中非常受欢迎。
zh_hant: 但在英國，壁球在某些家庭中非常受歡迎。

text: Yeah, what's squash?
Squash is very strong,
zh: 浓缩水果汁，你需要加水
zh_hant: 濃縮水果汁，你需要加水

text: concentrated fruit juice, and you add water to it
to get a drink.
zh: 但如果你尝橙味浓缩果汁
zh_hant: 但如果你嘗橙味濃縮果汁

text: But if you taste orange squash
rather than fresh orange juice,
zh: 它更多是一种人造味道，而不是真正的橙味。
zh_hant: 它更多是一種人造味道，而不是真正的橙味。

text: it has more of a fake flavour than a real flavour of orange.
zh: 让我们回顾一下本集学到的语言点。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下本集學到的語言點。

text: Let's recap the language we've looked at in this episode.
Starting with prefer.
zh: 如果你 prefer 某样东西，意思是你比另一样更喜欢它。
zh_hant: 如果你 prefer 某樣東西，意思是你比另一樣更喜歡它。

text: If you prefer something, it means you like it more than something else.
zh: 例如，比起果汁，我更 prefer 水。
zh_hant: 例如，比起果汁，我更 prefer 水。

text: For example, I prefer water to juice.
zh: 我们也可以用 would prefer 来谈论具体的选项。
zh_hant: 我們也可以用 would prefer 來談論具體的選項。

text: We can also use prefer with would to talk about a specific option.
zh: 例如，我更 would prefer 喝咖啡而不是茶。
zh_hant: 例如，我更 would prefer 喝咖啡而不是茶。

text: For example, I would prefer to have coffee than tea.
zh: 我们也可以用 would rather 来表达同样的意思。
zh_hant: 我們也可以用 would rather 來表達同樣的意思。

text: And we can use would rather in the same way.
zh: 所以，我 would rather 喝咖啡而不是茶。
zh_hant: 所以，我 would rather 喝咖啡而不是茶。

text: So, I would rather have coffee than tea.
zh: 像可乐或柠檬水这样的汽水有
zh_hant: 像可樂或檸檬水這樣的汽水有

text: Fizzy drinks like cola or lemonade have little gassy bubbles in them.
zh: 像可乐或柠檬水这样的碳酸饮料里含有许多小气泡。
zh_hant: 像可樂或檸檬水這樣的碳酸飲料裡含有許多小氣泡。

text: Yes, but if water is fizzy,
we call this sparkling water.
zh: 所以气泡水有气泡，相反的是无气泡的。
zh_hant: 所以氣泡水有氣泡，相反的是無氣泡的。

text: So, sparkling water has bubbles, and the opposite is still.
Still water has no bubbles,
zh: 你可以从水龙头接，也就是自来水。
zh_hant: 你可以從水龍頭接，也就是自來水。

text: and you can get it from the tap, tap water.
zh: 本期《简易英语》就到这里，
zh_hant: 本期《簡易英語》就到這裡，

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English,
zh: 但你可以在我们的网站上免费下载工作纸
zh_hant: 但你可以在我們的網站上免費下載工作紙

text: but you can find a free worksheet to download on our website
bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 我们下周会带来另一期简易英语。
zh_hant: 我們下週會帶來另一期簡易英語。

text: And we'll be back next week with another episode in Easy English.
See you then.
Bye.
